name: boost-velo-ios
description: BOOST (VELO) — app iOS con Capacitor. El diseño vive en design/ y no se toca.

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx http-server www -p 5173 -c-1
scripts.demo:deploy: npm run demo && npx wrangler pages deploy demo --project-name boost-demo --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.beta:deploy: npm run beta && npx wrangler pages deploy beta --project-name boost-app --branch main --commit-dirty=true
